subject: CAIQ evidence automation & upload instructions for Clearwater
messages:
From: Alex Reed <security@cloudassure.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: audits+clearwater@acmecloud.com
Date: Mon, 28 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0500
Subject: CAIQ evidence automation & initial checklist for Clearwater Financial

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this on. Clearwater has asked us to validate the CAIQ mapping (CSA CAIQ v4) and ingest a machine-readable evidence bundle where possible to speed review. For efficiency we prefer a single signed-presigned S3 upload or secure portal drop for artifacts, plus an annotated CAIQ matrix that points to specific artifacts.

Key artifacts we’d like to receive in the first batch (priority A):
- Network topology diagram and VPC boundary (PDF)
- KMS key rotation evidence and KMS policy snapshot (logs + policy)
- Runtime request logs (sample window: 2026-11-15 to 2026-11-21) with redaction guidance if PII present
- Multi-tenant isolation description + config screenshots (tenant tagging, keystore segregation)
- CI/CD pipeline attestation for build artifact signing

Can you confirm whether Redwood can produce an automated "evidence bundle" (zip/manifest) and provide:
1) preferred upload method (presigned S3, secure FTP, or portal)
2) point contact for each artifact above
3) whether you can produce an annotated CAIQ spreadsheet linking to artifact file names/locations

I’ve attached a one-page checklist to align scope (CAIQ_request_checklist.pdf). If we can get the first bundle by EOD next Tuesday (2027-01-04) that would keep us on schedule.

Best,
Alex Reed
CloudAssure — Technical Audit Lead
security@cloudassure.com

--
Attachment: CAIQ_request_checklist.pdf (1 page)

From: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
To: Alex Reed <security@cloudassure.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 28 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ evidence automation & initial checklist for Clearwater Financial

Alex — thanks for the clear ask and the checklist. We can definitely produce an annotated CAIQ matrix and automate a first-pass evidence bundle. Proposed approach:

1) Upload: We’ll create a time-limited presigned S3 bucket share and a redundant secure portal link (your choice). We will provide MD5 checksums and a manifest.json that maps files to CAIQ control IDs.

2) Ownership: I’ll own coordination. Marissa will handle runtime logs and redaction guidance; Jonas will provide infra diagrams and tenancy isolation artifacts; Naomi will be the primary uploader for artifacts and manifest ingestion.

3) Timeline: We can produce an initial bundle containing the priority-A artifacts by 2027-01-04 if we get confirmation on the presigned upload method today. We will follow with cadence deliveries for priority-B items next week.

Actions I’m taking now:
- Attaching an evidence_manifest_template.xlsx we’ll fill in (initial version expected by 2026-12-30).
- Scheduling a quick walkthrough today at 13:00 ET to confirm redaction rules and log window (15 minutes).

Marissa/Jonas/Naomi — please confirm capacity for the artifacts listed and any blockers.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: evidence_manifest_template.xlsx (stub)

From: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
To: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com, Alex Reed <security@cloudassure.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Dec 2026 11:10:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ evidence automation & initial checklist for Clearwater Financial

Kimberly / Alex — quick update from SecOps on artifact readiness:

- Runtime logs: We can extract the requested 2026-11-15 -> 2026-11-21 window. We will redact user-visible PII fields and replace with stable pseudonyms per our redaction playbook. Naomi will upload the sanitized logs.
- KMS rotation: We will provide the key policy snapshot and rotation schedule, plus KMS audit log extracts showing rotation events.
- Network topology & tenancy isolation: Jonas will export the VPC diagram and tenant tag audit report. We’ll include config screenshots for the keystore segregation and sample IAM role bindings.

Question for Alex: for log sampling do you require full request headers or just token-auth events? Token-level data is sensitive; we can provide header hashes instead if that suffices.

I’ve attached the internal log_extraction_playbook to show how we sanitize and package logs. We plan to stage artifacts in a locked S3 prefix and provide a presigned manifest and checksums.

Target delivery: initial package by 2027-01-04 EOD. If Alex confirms header hashing is acceptable, we’ll proceed without further escalation.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security Operations
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: log_extraction_playbook.md (internal playbook)

From: Alex Reed <security@cloudassure.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 28 Dec 2026 14:42:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ evidence automation & initial checklist for Clearwater Financial

Kimberly — perfect, thanks for the quick alignment. Header hashing is fine for our purposes; please include a short note in the manifest describing the hash algorithm used.

Upload instructions we prefer: presigned S3 to the folder we’ll provide, with a single manifest.csv mapping CAIQ IDs to filenames. Please set object ACLs to private and rotate presigned links after 72 hours. We’ll also accept portal upload if presigned S3 is not possible.

DocuSign: please have an authorized Redwood sign the attestation (linked) confirming the artifacts are accurate representations; I’ve included a DocuSign link in the related_links. We will start ingesting the bundle as soon as we receive the presigned URL and manifest.

HubSpot ticket: CLR-78-AUD (https://hubspot.com/ticket/CLR-78-audit) — we’ll attach artifacts there for tracking.

Thanks again — looking forward to the walkthrough at 13:00 ET.

Alex Reed
CloudAssure — Technical Audit Lead
security@cloudassure.com

--
Attachment: presigned_upload_instructions.txt (instructions & sample curl)
